The arima lane wrote a gated Householder QR the same night (DEVIATION 678, arima/impl/linalg/batched/least_squares.mojo), and this pass reached it. WHAT WAS ACTUALLY REUSED, because "we already have a QR" would be too generous: the THREE SCALAR CHOICES that deviation wrote down -- the reflector sign s = -sign(a_jj), u1 = a_jj - r_jj, and tau = (-s*u1)/normx -- are LIFTED into core/householder_qr.mojo as qr_reflector_r / _u1 / _tau and live in exactly one place (DEVIATION 586). The LOOP was not lifted and could not be: arima's is one thread per series, serial ascending, sized for n <= 17, and PCA's shape is one matrix of n_samples x n_features at the shipped size, so importing it would compile, run, and be unusable (DEVIATION 587, a block fold instead of a serial one; DEVIATION 589, TSQR with a slice count that is a pure function of the shape). TWO deliberate divergences from DEVIATION 678, both because this route feeds an SVD instead of a back substitution: NO RANK TEST (DEVIATION 588 -- a rank-deficient R is a ZERO SINGULAR VALUE, and importing arima's refusal would make 'full' raise on a constant feature that 'jacobi' accepts), and the reflector's division pinned through identical_div where arima's is a bare `/`. The tail is a ONE-SIDED Jacobi SVD of the n_cols x n_cols R (DEVIATION 590), sharing jacobi_rotation_cs and _rot_sub/_rot_add with the shipped eigensolver, which was refactored in the same commit so there is one spelling; the host ordering, truncation, ratios and noise variance are the SHARED order_truncate_spectrum (DEVIATION 591). The device Jacobi closed every rotation with four barriers, the (c, s) pick, the column update, the row update and the eigenvector update. At Istella-S's 220 columns that is 24,090 rotations and 96,360 barriers a sweep, and OLS runs 12 sweeps there. The last three phases share a cell only in the 2 x 2 block {p, q} x {p, q}, and the eigenvector update shares none, so they are now ONE phase: each lane does its own column pair then its own row pair, the lane owning k == p does the 2 x 2 block in the old column-then-row order, and every lane does its eigenvector pair. The rotation order, the arithmetic spelling, both folds and the sweep test are untouched. check_jacobi_merged_phases_equal_four_phase holds the new kernel equal to the old one at every output cell and at all three info slots, at n = 2, 3, 11, 33, 64, 129 and 220, and check_jacobi_is_a_pure_function_of_its_input still holds it to the host replay. A parallel rotation order would remove more barriers and WOULD move bits, so it is not taken.
